**LOGO / BRANDING**
> **Celsius**
> *Experts in keeping things cool*
> (Logo consists of the word "Celsius" in bold, dark blue sans-serif font. To the left of the text is a stylized icon of three wavy lines representing air or cooling, with a small circle/dot at the end of the top line. Below the brand name is the tagline in small font.)

**HEADLINE**
> **INDUSTRIAL SOLUTIONS**

**SUB-HEADLINE**
> Celsius Industrial Cooling Solutions:

**BODY TEXT**
> Celsius excels in tailored air conditioning solutions for industries, featuring brands like Mitsubishi, Daikin, and Samsung.
>
> Key features include energy-efficient solutions, precise temperature regulation, and robust reliability.
>
> Applications span manufacturing, storage, data centers, and processing plants, ensuring operational continuity and cost-efficiency.
>
> Celsius is your trusted partner for precision, efficiency, and reliability, addressing the unique demands of industrial environments

**VISUAL ELEMENTS / GRAPHICS**
> *   **Main Image:** A 3D architectural rendering of an industrial building (appears to be a multi-story factory or plant) in grayscale/white. The building features a sloped roof with visible HVAC units installed on top.
> *   **Background Graphic:** A large, abstract blue shape (gradient from light cyan to darker blue) located in the bottom right corner behind the building illustration.
> *   **Page Number:** A dark blue rounded square containing the number "11" in white text, located in the bottom left corner.

**COLOR SWATCHES**
> *   **Primary Blue (Logo/Text):** Dark Navy Blue
> *   **Headline Gradient:** Cyan to Bright Blue gradient
> *   **Body Text:** Black/Dark Gray
> *   **Accent Color:** Light to Dark Cyan/Blue (Graphic element)
